EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No. PAS/LAND/ACQVI/07/FI/249A/58.
Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4/3/15/2012/VE/175.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the government intends to acquire the following land servitude which is required for a public purpose:

Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired: Under mentioned land shown in the surveyor General’s plan of F. V. P. 23, Supplement No. 48, Sheet No. 62, situated in the village of Urubokka, Urubokka Grama Niladari Division, Pasgoda Divisional Secretary’s Division in Matara District Southern Province.
